connector.name: tc39-mcp
connector.registryDescription: Independent MCP server for the TC39 specs (ECMA-262 + ECMA-402): clauses, search, diffs, history.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.xyzzylabs.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package tc39-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the xyzzylabs account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.
